segments.contextAfter: `attributes`: The file attributes for the new directory. You can set the owner and group numbers, file permissions, and modification date. If you specify `nil` for this parameter, the directory is created according to the umask(2) macOS Developer Tools Manual Page of the process. The Supporting Types section lists the global constants used as keys in the `attributes` dictionary. Some of the keys, such as [`hfsCreatorCode`](fileattributekey/hfscreatorcode.md) and [`hfsTypeCode`](fileattributekey/hfstypecode.md), do not apply to directories.
